Park with Kids.instructions: Estimate the probability of reaching today's 10000-step goal conditional on completing the planned 90-minute Park with Kids activity today. Start at 5000 current steps and treat this activity as the only source of additional steps. Use its supplied plan and historical additional-step counts as evidence without prescribing the historical success fraction as the probability. Do not include a chance of selecting or completing the activity. This is a separate Yes/No forecast, not one category in a distribution across activities; do not combine or normalize its probability with the other alternatives.

criteria.true: 5000 current steps plus the additional steps from Park with Kids is at least 10000. Exactly 5000 additional steps is success.
criteria.false: 5000 current steps plus the additional steps from Park with Kids is less than 10000; the activity adds fewer than 5000 steps.
